source.note: All arithmetic below reuses the frozen gate records; the narrowly passing four-thread experiment was not rerun.

fixed400_positive_terminal_diagnostic.warning: The 1.11-second cross-family median is not the terminal floor of the registered iid2 performance gate, whose measured median is 0.4299 seconds.

interpretation_A_ratchet_against_current.conclusion: A pure additive capability step cannot pass a ratchet comparison. However, the frozen iid2 data do not prove that terminal authority alone exhausts the budget: about 0.529 seconds remains outside the median single terminal, so a future replacement that both adds ability and deletes roughly 0.480 seconds of current nonterminal work is not arithmetically impossible.

interpretation_B_fixed_reference_against.conclusion: The fixed reference leaves large isolated single-request headroom but almost no frozen four-thread bootstrap headroom. Adding 0.15 seconds to every request is not shown compliant: it would exceed the tightest observed pair's 1.8x allowance unless offset by structural savings or unless the update is not exercised by that workload. A real modified path must rerun the full gate; stage arithmetic cannot authorize promotion.

conditional_negative_update_boundary.description: A deterministic update that executes only after the sole current LP returns a nonpositive margin would leave the positive iid2 timing control unchanged but would add latency to most UNKNOWN requests.
conditional_negative_update_boundary.governance: It may still be one algorithm rather than a fallback menu, but frontend responsiveness must be measured on a preregistered negative workload as well as on the retained positive control. Passing only the bypassed positive control would be insufficient evidence.
conditional_negative_update_boundary.reason: It is the closest production negative margin and exercises the added cell-update path; this suggestion is a policy test design, not a prediction that the case will be solved.

decision_required.question: Should future response gates compare against the current promoted 59 path (ratchet) or the frozen old 43 reference path?
decision_required.unchanged_restrictions: The choice does not change any prohibition or the terminal proof boundary.
decision_required.no_algorithm_authorization: No new cell update is authorized by this arithmetic record.
